canada.title: Video captures woman allegedly assaulting driving instructor in Langley

canada.title: Elderly woman hurt during residential robbery, Winnipeg police say
canada.summary: An elderly woman was injured when a group of armed robbers dragged her onto the floor during a residential robbery this week, Winnipeg police say.

canada.title: Intake of Crime Stoppers tips in Toronto, surrounding areas paused after data breach
canada.summary: Toronto Crime Stoppers has temporarily stopped accepting tips after it said more than 175,000 of them were stolen by hackers earlier this year, alongside nearly 15,000 names.

canada.title: City councillor calls for independent investigation into fatal Calgary bus explosion
canada.summary: A week after a deadly bus explosion in northeast Calgary, the area councillor is calling for an independent investigation into the crash. But two experts say incidents like this one are rare, and the bus model involved in the crash adheres to strict testing and maintenance guidelines.

canada.title: After 72 years, Atikamekw baby will be reburied in home community of Manawan
canada.summary: More than 70 years after leaving his home in the northern Quebec community of Manawan, an Atikamekw baby's body was found in Quebec City following the exhumation of a common grave.

canada.title: Quebec Superior Court hears arguments to suspend Montreal bylaw banning insults to police

canada.title: ‘Comfort kills dreams’: Family of Prince Albert soldier killed in CFB Wainwright fire remembers him as a dreamer
canada.summary: The family of Shaun Farrell, one of four soldiers who died in a recent fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright, spoke to reporters Thursday, outlining an extraordinary life filled with big dreams that was cut tragically short.

canada.title: N.S. premier says the time will come for written agreements for data centre
canada.summary: At some point an agreement in writing will be required between the Nova Scotia government and the company that wants to build a data centre here, but Premier Tim Houston says that point has yet to arrive.

canada.title: NDP rejects claim from Scott Moe that it used AI to create health-care plan

canada.title: Fall storm could bring 15-25 cm of snow to northern Manitoba
